context: Mei and Aoi tidy up the cafe after a busy day.
purpose: Casual register; adverbs (とりあえず/通常/決して/きちんと/どうしても) in natural home.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: とりあえず、テーブルを拭いちゃうね。
lines.en: For now, I'll wipe the tables.
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 通常より、今日は忙しかったね。
lines.style: soft warm woman voice, gentle tired delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: カップは、きちんと並べておくね。
lines.en: I'll line up the cups neatly.
lines.style: diligent barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: どうしても、この棚が片付かないの。
lines.en: I just can't get this shelf tidy.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm rueful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 決して、無理しなくていいよ。
lines.en: You really don't have to push yourself.
lines.style: warm barista voice, soft warm caring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: とりあえず、明日に回そうか。
lines.en: For now, shall we leave it for tomorrow?
lines.style: soft woman voice, gentle warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 通常通り、明日も開けるしね。
lines.en: We open as usual tomorrow too.
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm reassuring delivery throughout

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: きちんと閉めて、今日は帰ろう。
lines.en: Let's close up properly and head home.
lines.style: gentle woman voice, soft warm closing delivery throughout
